pack.name: Official Programming / Software Engineering
pack.description: Small, text-only engineering tasks for code review and API design. This source pack never executes submitted code.

benchmark.name: Software Engineering Essentials
benchmark.description: Static engineering judgment with deterministic answer checks where a concise contract is appropriate.

tasks.name: Review a null-handling contract
tasks.prompt: Review the stated behavior as a senior engineer. Identify the main correctness risk and propose the smallest safe contract-level fix. Do not execute code.

cases.prompt: A function is documented as `find_user(id) -> User`, but it returns null when the ID is absent and callers immediately read `user.email`. State the minimal safe API correction.
cases.expected: Return an explicit not-found result or raise a documented not-found error; callers must not dereference a missing user.

tasks.context: Text-only static review. No code execution, filesystem access, or network access is provided.

tasks.name: Design a stable error contract
tasks.prompt: Give a concise API design answer that is explicit about caller behavior, machine-readable fields, and compatibility. Do not invent an executable environment.

cases.prompt: A JSON HTTP API currently returns either `{"error":"missing"}` or an HTML error page for an absent resource. State the smallest stable contract that clients should receive.
cases.expected: Return a documented JSON error shape with a stable code such as `not_found`, a human message, and the appropriate 404 status for every missing resource.

tasks.context: Text-only API reasoning. Docker-backed coding sandbox support is unavailable in this slice.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Identifies the actual contract or safety failure without proposing unsafe execution.

criteria.name: Minimal safe change
criteria.description: Proposes a small, compatible correction with clear caller behavior.

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.description: Communicates the recommendation in precise engineering language.

execution.requirement: Text-only static reasoning; no code execution, filesystem access, or network access is provided.
execution.notes: Docker-backed coding sandbox is not implemented in this slice. Execution-required coding tests remain unavailable and must not be run as ordinary text prompts.
